WITH high_risk_patients AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.patownerref AS patient_id
    FROM 
        "mental".assessmentbasics AS ab
    JOIN 
        "mental".assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr
    ON 
        ab.abkey = asr.asrkey
    WHERE 
        asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')
        OR (asr.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::INT > 15
        OR (asr.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::INT > 15
),
very_risky_encounters AS (
    SELECT 
        e.enckey AS encounter_id,
        e.timemark AS encounter_timestamp,
        e.patref AS patient_id,
        e.clinid AS clinician_id,
        e.facid AS facility_id,
        e.missappt AS missed_appointments,
        e.txbarrier AS treatment_barriers,
        e.nxapptdt AS next_appointment_date,
        e.dqscore AS data_quality_score,
        e.assesscomplete AS assessment_completeness
    FROM 
        "mental".encounters AS e
    JOIN 
        high_risk_patients AS hr
    ON 
        e.patref = hr.patient_id
)
SELECT 
    v.encounter_id,
    v.encounter_timestamp,
    v.patient_id,
    v.clinician_id,
    v.facility_id,
    v.missed_appointments,
    v.treatment_barriers,
    v.next_appointment_date,
    v.data_quality_score,
    v.assessment_completeness
INTO 
    audit_table
FROM 
    very_risky_encounters AS v;

WITH high_risk_patients AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.patownerref AS patient_id
    FROM 
        "mental".assessmentbasics AS ab
    JOIN 
        "mental".assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr
    ON 
        ab.abkey = asr.asrkey
    WHERE 
        asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')
        OR (asr.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::INT > 15
        OR (asr.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::INT > 15
),
very_risky_encounters AS (
    SELECT 
        e.enckey AS encounter_id,
        e.timemark AS encounter_timestamp,
        e.patref AS patient_id,
        e.clinid AS clinician_id,
        e.facid AS facility_id,
        e.missappt AS missed_appointments,
        e.txbarrier AS treatment_barriers,
        e.nxapptdt AS next_appointment_date,
        e.dqscore AS data_quality_score,
        e.assesscomplete AS assessment_completeness
    FROM 
        "mental".encounters AS e
    JOIN 
        high_risk_patients AS hr
    ON 
        e.patref = hr.patient_id
)
SELECT 
    v.encounter_id,
    v.encounter_timestamp,
    v.patient_id,
    v.clinician_id,
    v.facility_id,
    v.missed_appointments,
    v.treatment_barriers,
    v.next_appointment_date,
    v.data_quality_score,
    v.assessment_completeness
INTO 
    audit_table
FROM 
    very_risky_encounters AS v;
